liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Alhambra** (2 reviews): The Alhambra section at the end of Terrapin was beautiful; The listener argues the ending is a full Terrapin, not a separate Alhambra [13][14]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): The band sounded unsure of the song due to short jams initially; Jerry's wha pedal solo sounded like he was tearing the building down [13]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-03-18.145509.mtx.motb.0222.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 196 min [1]
- **gd1977-03-18.140916.ecm270.menke.sirmick.flac2496**: source not stated; 21 songs; 192 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1977-03-18.145158.ecm270.menke.sirmick.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 196 min [4]
- **gd77-03-18.sbd.unknown.254.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 173 min; rated 4.31/5 by 68 [7]. Said about its sound: This version sounds much crisper and clearer than a previous rough copy; Strange sound problems occur in the first two songs and a cut in Fire; The sound is rich, with the band plugging along like a locomotive [12][19][20]
- **gd1977-03-18.sbd.clugston.254-patch.79098.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 2 songs; 18 min; rated 4.25/5 by 8 [10]

## Around the show

- The performance indicates the band is heading toward their monster east coast tour [17]
- A cut prevents hearing the full song, though the beginning is good [22]
- This Scarlet and Fire combination outsmokes the much overrated Cornell version [15]
- This show is worth the trip for the first Fire, like 2-26 for Terrapin [18]
- The listener considers this Sugaree the best ever, bar none [20]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-03-18.145509.mtx.motb.0222.flac16**: source: Matrix by Derek McCabe [1]. Also: SBD source is missing Promised Land and Ship of Fools, patched from AUD; A tape flip occurred on the SBD source during Fire on the Mountain [1]
- **gd1977-03-18.140916.ecm270.menke.sirmick.flac2496**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by SIRMick and Bob Menke, Matt Smith, Charlie Miller; source: Source: Sony ECM 270's > Sony TC 152SD > Master Cassettes (Maxell UD C90) - Recorded from front row balcony right side by Bob Menke; [2]. Also: Audience recording ends at 18:04 of Not Fade Away, patched from MOTB matrix [2]
- **gd1977-03-18.145158.ecm270.menke.sirmick.flac1644**: taped by Bob Menke; transferred by Sirmick; source: Sony ECM 270's > Sony TC 152SD > Master Cassettes (Maxell UD C90) - Recorded from front row balcony right side by Bob Menke [4]. Also: Audience recording ends at 18:04 of Not Fade Away, patched from MOTB matrix [4]
- **gd77-03-18.sbd.unknown.254.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBDMR @ 7.5 ips> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN, with AUD patches [7]
- **gd1977-03-18.sbd.clugston.254-patch.79098.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: SBD 1: SBDMR @ 7.5 ips>DAT>CD>EAC>SHN (track 2 and 3) SBD 2: SBD>(unknown analog/digital gens)>CD>EAC>SHN (track 1) AUD: Master (R. Bertrando Sony… [10]. Also: Scott Clugston patched the AUD source into the SBD reel flip in FOTM [10]
